channels.name: ru.subject
channels.method: Original pedestrian actor identity at every Native frame
channels.reference_frame: Native actor id and original frame map
channels.uncertainty: Identity joins require independent original audit

channels.name: st.roadway
channels.method: Authored roadway geometry with original map and pixel review
channels.reference_frame: authored road and original Native map
channels.uncertainty: Road status requires independent original audit

channels.name: kin.position
channels.method: Original pedestrian transform at each Native frame
channels.reference_frame: authored road coordinates and original frame map
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms frame bracket plus Native pose uncertainty

channels.name: kin.path_length
channels.method: Sum distances of source-joined pedestrian positions
channels.uncertainty: Depends on observed entry and exit and frame sampling

channels.name: kin.heading
channels.reference_frame: authored curb tangent and original pedestrian positions
channels.uncertainty: 50 ms frame bracket; stationary frames have no heading

channels.name: st.road_edge
channels.method: Authored curb segments independently verified against Native map and pixels
channels.uncertainty: Map projection and actual curb status require independent audit

channels.name: st.crosswalk
channels.method: Authored absence of crosswalk independently verified against Native map and pixels
channels.uncertainty: Crosswalk exception cannot be settled by authored claim alone

limitations: Measured route alternatives are not legal thresholds
Native execution and independent source audit remain unverified
